Evidence & scope

The complete six retained 2026H1 issuer physical-page texts (2,5,6,7,9,85), complete Japanese company text and complete English Nexdata About were actually read in this phase. Physical p8 was additionally extracted and read to complete the business-model continuation, and p9/p85 were rendered and visually inspected with financial and ownership headers/columns. Issuer p6 identifies Datatang (Beijing) Technology Co.,Ltd / 数据堂（北京）科技股份有限公司, NEEQ831428; p7 describes commercial licensed resource service, crowdsourced custom collection/annotation/quality checking and customer deployment solutions. The issuer report is explicitly unaudited (p2), covers January 1–June 30 2026 (p5), and reports p9 revenue RMB180,323,485.50 versus RMB124,942,039.87 for prior corresponding period, in yuan; no independently audited/current-run-rate revenue claim is made. P85 explicitly reports Nexdata Technology Inc. 100% direct, Japanese Datatang 51% direct and named Nexdata Hong Kong/Singapore 100% indirect holdings. Japanese text explicitly says Datatang operates as Nexdata; distinguish legal entities but propose one Datatang/Nexdata supplier group. Retain both original mandatory records, no two-group increment. Public service/licensing and personnel descriptions establish a bounded commercial offer, not a particular corpus license, independently audited quality, verified customers or active worker count. Six exact already-three-role-passed assertions keep their wording/digests and require separate coordinator metadata/group acceptance before any admission. Only stated pages are newly read, not the full 107-page report or full 2025 report; predecessor histories remain attributed. Coordinator independently accepted the stated text/page/visual scopes and group identity. Retained operating-brand organization records are intentionally not counted as additional supplier groups.
